dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source system), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux
evidence: COPY MCPAREA / ORCA-SPA / LINKAREA pattern typical of JMA ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software – confirmation screen SID1 for patient registration/receipt entry subsystem
purpose.summary: This program is a screen-handling subprogram (SID1 confirmation screen) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It evaluates MCP events (LINK, PUTG/CLICKED) to initialise or navigate between screens, and calls ORCDBMAIN to put/transition windows. It handles back-navigation and OK registration actions from the confirmation screen.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (19 copybooks) for screen and data areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
EVALUATE with ALSO for multi-condition dispatch on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT
EXIT PROGRAM used as subprogram return
Japanese Shift-JIS/EUC comments encoded in latin-1 (mojibake visible)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary ORCDBMAIN call interface
MCP (Message Control Program) framework typical of JMA ORCA
verdict.notes: Comment text is Japanese encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded here as latin-1 producing mojibake. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. High copy_count (19) reflects the ORCA framework's copybook-heavy architecture. Only 1 PIC clause in working-storage because most data definitions come from copybooks.
